{{ define "main" }} {{ $site := hugo.Data.site }} {{ $author := hugo.Data.author }} {{/* JSON-LD is built as dicts and emitted once via jsonify|safeJS — inside a script element Go's contextual escaping would otherwise re-encode every interpolated value. */}} {{ $person := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "Person" "name" $author.name "url" site.BaseURL "image" (absURL $author.avatar) "description" (plainify $author.bio_html | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace) }} {{/* The books axis toggles the whole section off the home page (the books/ series pages themselves still build and stay in the nav). The series ItemList JSON-LD describes the on-page list, so it goes with it. */}} {{ $design := $site.design | default dict }} {{ $booksAxis := index (where hugo.Data.theme.axes "key" "books") 0 }} {{ $showBooks := ne ((index $design "books") | default $booksAxis.default) "no" }} {{ if $showBooks }} {{ $items := slice }} {{ range $i, $s := hugo.Data.series.series }} {{ $first := partial "book-by-slug.html" (index $s.books 0) }} {{ $item := dict "@type" "BookSeries" "name" $s.title "url" (absURL (printf "series/%s/" $s.slug)) "author" (dict "@type" "Person" "name" $author.name) }} {{ with $first }}{{ $item = merge $item (dict "image" (absURL .cover)) }}{{ end }} {{ $items = $items | append (dict "@type" "ListItem" "position" (add $i 1) "item" $item) }} {{ end }} {{ $list := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "ItemList" "name" (printf "Series by %s" $author.name) "itemListElement" $items }} {{ end }} {{/* Slot engine: render sections in the order given by the tenant's site.json (home.sections), defaulting to the standard author-site flow. Each name maps to layouts/_partials/sections/.html. Sections with a home-visibility axis are skipped when it says no. */}} {{ $visibility := dict "hero" "hero_home" "books" "books" "bio" "bio_home" "authors" "authors" }} {{ $sections := $site.home.sections | default (slice "hero" "books" "posts" "bio" "authors" "newsletter") }} {{ range $sections }} {{ $shown := true }} {{ with index $visibility . }} {{ $axis := index (where hugo.Data.theme.axes "key" .) 0 }} {{ $shown = ne ((index $design .) | default $axis.default) "no" }} {{ end }} {{ if not $shown }}{{ continue }}{{ end }} {{ partial (printf "sections/%s.html" .) $ }} {{ end }} {{ end }}
